description: XE recovery phrase test vectors (xeprotocol/core#1005). An XE recovery phrase is the BIP39 entropy-to-mnemonic encoding of the 32-byte ed25519 seed with the BIP39 English wordlist: seed || first 8 bits of SHA-256(seed) gives 264 bits, read most significant bit first as 24 word indexes of 11 bits. Exactly 24 words. No PBKDF2, no passphrase, no derivation path: the words are the seed. bip39: the official BIP39 English vectors with 32-byte entropy, from trezor/python-mnemonic vectors.json, entropy and mnemonic only (the PBKDF2 seed and xprv columns do not apply). xe: seed (hex), phrase, public_key (hex ed25519 public key from the seed, RFC 8032) and address (hex SHA-256 of the UTF-8 bytes 'xe/account/v1' followed by the 32-byte public key).
